releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.194: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder support Custom weekday recurrence. All previous repeat options for each section, saved entries, snooze timing and limits, ringtone, notifications and unrelated features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web update 326: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder saved entries no longer display the event-time reminder label or reminder sound/snooze settings. Existing and future saved entries are covered; automatic event-time reminders and all reminder settings remain active.
